articles.summary: Today, Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) announced it is donating nearly $125,000 to 13 off-road and snowmobile clubs and organizations across the United States and Canada through its TRAILS GRANTS program . Together with grants awarded to 14 organizations this spring , Polaris has given more than $250,000 through the program in 2026. "Strong riding communities depend on the people who put in the work to keep trails safe, accessible and ready to ride," said Mike Speetzen, CEO of Polaris. "For two decades, Polaris has been proud to stand alongside these volunteers and organizations, caring for the places riders love today while helping preserve access for generations to come." For two decades, the grants have supported locally led projects focused on trail development and maintenance, rider safety and education, and protecting access to outdoor recreation. Since the program's inception, Polaris has invested more than $4 million in TRAILS GRANTS funding to nearly 470 organizations across the
articles.title: POLARIS MARKS THE CLOSE OF 20TH ANNIVERSARY YEAR OF TRAILS GRANTS WITH MORE THAN $250,000 IN 2026 GIVING

articles.summary: Brock Heger Drives Cayden MacCachren's No.1821 RZR Pro R Factory to Overall UTV Victory, as Joe Terrana and Ethan Groom Round out Podium in First-Ever Cabo-to-Cabo Race Polaris and RZR Factory Racing capped the 2026 SCORE World Championship season with a dominant 1-2-3 overall UTV sweep at the 59th SCORE Baja 1000. Brock Heger and co-driver Justin Morgan claimed the overall UTV victory in Cayden MacCachren's No. 1821 purple RZR Pro R Factory, followed by Joe Terrana and Rodrigo Ampudia in second and Ethan Groom and Justin Munyon in third. The podium sweep came on the race's historic first Cabo-to-Cabo course, which started and finished in San José del Cabo. After months of preparation and a combined 10,500 miles of course pre-running by the RZR Factory Racing drivers, the team lined up for the 943-mile race, a grueling test of driver skill and machine performance. The demanding course quickly tested the field with heavy dust and limited passing opportunities throughout the opening
articles.title: RZR FACTORY RACING SWEEPS UTV OVERALL PODIUM WITH DOMINANT PERFORMANCE AT 59TH SCORE BAJA 1000
